title: Federated TD Learning in Heterogeneous Environments with Average Rewards: A Two-timescale Approach with Polyak-Ruppert Averaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.21370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) provides a promising way to speedup training in reinforcement learning when one has access to multiple edge devices that can operate in parallel. Recently, it has been shown that even when these edge devices have access to different dynamic models---such as cars or robots with differing system configurations---an optimal convergence rate that has a linear speedup proportional to the number of devices is achievable. However, this result requires that the algorithm's stepsize be chosen in a manner that depends on the unknown model parameters. Also, it applies only to a discounted setting, which has been argued to fit episodic tasks better than continuing control tasks. In this paper, we obtain finite-time bounds for heterogeneous FRL with average rewards. We show that optimal convergence rate and linear speedup are achievable even with a universal stepsize choice, independent of the underlying dynamic

translated_title: 异构环境下基于平均奖励的联邦TD学习：一种结合Polyak-Ruppert平均的双时间尺度方法
translated_abstract: 联邦强化学习（FRL）为在拥有多个可并行运行的边缘设备时加速强化学习训练提供了一种有前景的途径。最近的研究表明，即使这些边缘设备具有不同的动态模型——例如具有不同系统配置的汽车或机器人——也可以实现与设备数量成正比线性加速的最优收敛速率。然而，这一结果要求算法的步长以依赖于未知模型参数的方式选取；此外，该结果仅适用于折扣设定，而这一设定被认为更适合情景任务而非持续控制任务。在本文中，我们获得了异构联邦强化学习在平均奖励设定下的有限时间收敛界。我们证明了即使采用与底层动态无关的通用步长选择，最优收敛速率和线性加速依然可以实现。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合Polyak-Ruppert平均的双时间尺度联邦TD学习方法，首次在平均奖励的异构环境中实现了最优收敛速率与线性加速，且无需使用依赖未知模型参数的步长。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-timescale federated TD learning approach with Polyak-Ruppert averaging, achieving optimal convergence rate and linear speedup in heterogeneous environments with average rewards, without requiring a stepsize that depends on unknown model parameters.
